en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Muhammad ibn Muslim asked him about a man who borrows a loan from another man and gives him collateral, either a servant, a vessel, or clothing.
Later, the borrower needs something from his belongings and seeks permission from the lender, who grants it.
Imam (as) said: "If the lender willingly allows it, then there is no harm."
I said: "Those among us narrate that any loan that brings benefit is invalid."
Imam (as) replied: "Isn't the best loan the one that brings benefit?"
